[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Suggested healthy dinner ideas featuring chicken breasts and ground beef:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Grilled Chicken Fajitas: Marinate chicken breasts in lime juice, olive oil, and spices, grill with bell peppers and onions, serve with whole wheat tortillas, avocado, and salsa.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Chicken and Quinoa Bowl: Roast chicken breasts with lemon and herbs, serve over quinoa with roasted vegetables like broccoli, carrots, and Brussels sprouts.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Chicken and Spinach Stuffed Bell Peppers: Fill bell peppers with cooked chicken, spinach, feta cheese, and brown rice, bake until tender.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Lemon Garlic Chicken with Roasted Asparagus: Marinate chicken breasts in lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil, roast with asparagus, serve with quinoa or brown rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Spaghetti Bolognese with a Twist: Use lean ground beef, add veggies like mushrooms, bell peppers, and onions to the sauce, serve with whole wheat spaghetti and steamed broccoli.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Tacos with Ground Beef and Avocado Salsa: Season ground beef with cumin and chili powder, serve in tacos with avocado salsa, lettuce, and whole wheat tortillas.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Stuffed Bell Peppers with Ground Beef and Rice: Fill bell peppers with cooked ground beef, cooked rice, and black beans, bake until tender.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Korean-Style Ground Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry: Cook ground beef with Gochujang sauce, stir-fry with vegetables like broccoli, carrots, and bell peppers, serve with brown rice or cauliflower rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Chicken and Beef Fajita Casserole: A casserole featuring both chicken breasts and ground beef, sautéed onions and bell peppers, served with whole wheat tortillas.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Beef and Chicken Meatball Subs: Mix ground beef and chicken breast to make meatballs, serve on whole wheat sub rolls with marinara sauce and melted mozzarella cheese.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the sound of the Chicken and Quinoa Bowl and the Korean-Style Ground Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry.
